simple.meaning: חֶבֶר (cheber) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a society ; also a spell.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 7 times in Deuteronomy, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, Hosea, beginning at Deuteronomy 18:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶבֶר (H2267) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חֶבֶר (cheber) / H2267 is traced through Deuteronomy 18:11, Psalms 58:6, Proverbs 21:9, Proverbs 25:24 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2267. cheber חֶ֫בֶר noun [masculine] company, association, spell — absolute חָ֑בֶר Deut 18:11 2 t.; construct חֶבֶר Hosea 6:9 ; plural חֲבָרִים Psa 58:6 , suffix חֲבָרַיִךְ Isa 47:9 , 11 — 1 company, band of (bad) priests Hosea 6:9 . 2 association, society (abstract), only in חָ֑בֶר בֵּית Prov 21:9 = 25:24 house of association , i. e. shared with a contentious woman (house in common, see RVm VB). 3 spell : a. as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with חָבַר (q. v.) Deut 18:11 ; Psa 58:6 . b. alone, of Babylonian magic Isa 47:9 , 11 (see Len Chald. Magic [1878]; Magie u. Wahrsage-kunst 1878; Scholz G-tzendienst u. Zauberwesen, 1877. 80 ff. Say TBA iii. 145 ff and Rel,. Bab 396 ff., 440 ff. ).
